page.layout: Two parallel columns of index lines under the running head "INDEX:". The left column runs from the top to the foot of the page, then the right column, which carries page numbers and continues the left-column lines. The right column ends with a fragment "tra-" at the foot. A page number stands at the top right.
page.notes: The right-column lines are a continuation of the left column; each left line and the right line beside it form one index entry. The page number "302" at the top right is hard to read and is marked [?]. The final "tra-" is cut off at the foot of the page and is a fragment. The line "pont. Rom. ætcetera ..." above is not on this page: it was an error and should be disregarded, so the left column ends at "Dei vocatus, subito mo-". The Cardinal's name in "Cardinalium" and the abbreviation "pont." (pontifex) are as printed. The scan is slightly faded at the top and right edge; some numbers, such as "3oz", "410.439" and "143.146.156", may be misread.
